title: Harness: apply bank / tight-trail only to trades flagged by an out-of-fold path-metric trigger file (Q11 rung 2 instrument)
note: [2026-10-22 EXITS-GIVEBACK-W43] Instrument for blocked units RQ-20261022-eba2-07/-08 (Programme 01 Q11 rung 2). BUILD (scripts/ only, default byte-identical): (a) scripts/research/path_metric_giveback.py --emit-triggers FILE writes one row per trade {trade_key, trigger} using the rung-1 FULL model fit on the OTHER calendar folds only (fitted P(big giveback) >= 0.5 at bar k); (b) backtest_pullback.py and backtest_trend.py take --trigger-file FILE, --trigger-action bank|tight and --trigger-all K (unconditional control: act on every trade still open at bar K). DONE WHEN: a smoke run on ada_pullback_2h shows an empty trigger file => arms byte-identical to A, a populated file => the action fires only on flagged trades, and tests cover both plus a self-test planting a leaky trigger the out-of-fold construction must reject. Gate: do not build before RQ-20261022-eba2-01 lands verdict pass (otherwise the instrument has no hypothesis behind it).
